author: Shirokamii
body:
I was thinking, of maybe hosting a story telling time on teamspeak.

So il let all your creative minds go mad, while making a story, each week some one from the staff will pick an story and i will read out loud on Wensday 10pm GMT

So il let you get to it!

Starts like : In A World! or in a land far far away. or think of something cool!
